corrected_fragment.qualitative_outcome: The panels support increased uptake/phagocytic activity of pHrodo-labeled FAP+ JS-1 targets by the αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR BMDM arm relative to WT and αCD163/LNP-Luc controls, and increased cytotoxicity against FAP+ JS-1 targets. They do not directly show target-cell counts.

visible_support: Panel A shows red pHrodo signal in merged fields, strongest in the αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR column. Panels B and D show the tallest phagocytic-index bars for αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR; panel C shows the corresponding flow-cytometry pHrodo/F4/80 plots. Panel F shows the tallest killing-efficiency bar for αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR. The supplied caption identifies these as phagocytosis and cytotoxicity assays.
derivation: Relationship is derived from the treatment-arm comparison displayed in the bar charts and flow/confocal panels; no target-cell number is printed or directly displayed.
